descricao_original: These images show continuous capillaries in highly vascularized adipose tissue. Capillaries branch extensively, insinuating among the adipocytes forming expansive capillary beds. Because of their narrow lumen, capillaries only allow erythrocytes to pass through in single file. Capillaries consists of only endothelial cells and their basal laminae. Hypodermis of the skin 400x
